//: Capability manifest for <DescTable> — svelte-pure-admin. See list.map.json / banded.map.json for the container-only model. CONTAINER ONLY: the label/value cells come from the sibling <DescTableItem>, fed through the default children slot — the harness passes slot content as plain text, so only the container is exercised. cols2 maps to the numeric `cols` prop via a const (svelte sets pa-desc-table--cols-2 only when cols===2). hasContainerQuery is an EXTRA flag (not an oracle feature): svelte emits the outer pa-desc-container ONLY when it's set, whereas keen always emits it — forcing it true in every scenario aligns svelte to keen's always-wrapped shape. capability.mjs reports it as a yellow EXTRA, which is expected.
